title: Bestbuy type store next to a movie theater
content: This is a new spot I just woke up from. It was a large electronics department store. I was in the TV section with all these huge TV's on the wall, showing demos. One of the TVs was ultra wide, thick like a fish tank, and had hyper realistic images inside, like looking at 3D models, not a TV. It was branded LG. There were a lot of employees but they all were standing around chatting with each other, not helping anyone. The floors were filthy, covered in trash. I noticed a movie theater next door and started to walk over. This was the strange part. I stood up and had a massive head rush and nearly fainted. The employees were telling me I was not getting enough hydrogen to my brain. I was fading in and out of consciousness but pulled myself back, just so I could tell the employee it was oxygen, a lack of oxygen to the brain was the problem. I kept trying to walk but legs were sandbags and the head rush finally won and I woke up.
